parameters.query: =WITH job AS (SELECT j.id,j.project_name,COALESCE(c.client_name,'Client') AS client_name FROM content_jobs j LEFT JOIN client_profiles c ON c.id=j.client_profile_id WHERE j.id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid), folder AS (SELECT id, regexp_replace(client_name || '_' || project_name || '_' || to_char(now(),'YYYY-MM-DD'),'[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+','_','g') AS folder_name, COALESCE(NULLIF('{{$json.drive_folder_id || ""}}',''),'PENDING_GOOGLE_DRIVE_CREATION') AS folder_id FROM job), update_job AS (UPDATE content_jobs SET drive_root_folder_id=(SELECT folder_id FROM folder), drive_root_folder_path=(SELECT folder_name FROM folder), updated_at=now() WHERE id=(SELECT id FROM job) RETURNING id), event_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_events (job_id,event_type,message,metadata) SELECT id,'drive_project_folder_prepared','Project Drive folder metadata prepared',jsonb_build_object('folder_name',folder_name,'folder_id',folder_id,'credential','GOOGLE_DRIVE_AI_CONTENT','parent_env','DEFAULT_PARENT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID') FROM folder) SELECT folder_id, folder_name FROM folder;
